rules.diagnosis_template: The package '{package_name}' has low functional cohesion (FCPP: {fcpp:.2f}). The modules/subpackages {{{isolated_nodes_str}}} do not invoke (directly or indirectly) functions of any other module in this package.
rules.recommendation_template: If these modules do not share data resources (check SCPP), consider moving them to a package more functionally related to them.

rules.diagnosis_template: The package '{package_name}' contains {n_groups} disconnected functional groups (FCPP: {fcpp:.2f}).
rules.recommendation_template: As there are {n_groups} groups of functionally connected modules {{{groups_str}}}, if these groups are not structurally connected (check SCPP), the package should be split into {n_groups} smaller subpackages.

rules.diagnosis_template: The package '{package_name}' has high functional cohesion (FCPP: {fcpp:.2f}). Almost all modules interact with each other.
rules.recommendation_template: Excellent functional organization. The package represents a unified functional block.

rules.diagnosis_template: The package '{package_name}' has medium functional cohesion (FCPP: {fcpp:.2f}). There is some interaction between modules.
rules.recommendation_template: Functional cohesion is acceptable, but could be improved by ensuring better integration or splitting distinct responsibilities.

rules.diagnosis_template: The package '{package_name}' has low functional cohesion (FCPP: {fcpp:.2f}) despite having no completely isolated nodes.
rules.recommendation_template: The interaction density is low. Modules are loosely coupled.
